title: Statement on consumer electronics tariffs
text: We are looking very seriously at tariffs on consumer electronics coming in from overseas. Apple Inc. has made commitments about building here, and we expect those commitments to be honoured. Companies that build in America will be treated very differently from companies that do not.
author: Donald J. Trump
note: Synthetic. Should match a tariff/AAPL watchlist rule.

title: Remarks on semiconductor supply
text: Chips are national security. Nvidia and Taiwan Semiconductor need to understand that export controls on advanced chips are being reviewed, and new restrictions are under consideration for certain destinations.
author: Donald J. Trump

title: Energy permitting order signed
text: Signed an executive order directing agencies to speed up permitting for drilling and pipeline projects. The energy sector has been held back by regulation for too long. Exxon and others have applications waiting.
author: The White House

title: Comments on imported vehicles
text: Imported cars are being looked at closely. General Motors and Ford Motor build here, and that matters. A tariff on imported vehicles and parts is under review, with a decision expected in the coming weeks.
author: Donald J. Trump

title: Defense procurement statement
text: A new defense contract for missile systems has been awarded. Lockheed Martin will be the prime contractor. Raytheon will supply components under a separate agreement.
author: The White House

title: Remarks on platform regulation
text: The big tech platforms need much stronger oversight. Google and Meta Platforms have too much control over what people see. An antitrust review is being considered.
author: Donald J. Trump

title: Statement on corporate taxation
text: We want a corporate tax cut for companies that manufacture in the United States. Lower taxes mean more investment and more plants being built here.
author: Donald J. Trump

title: An apple a day
text: Had a wonderful lunch today. They served an apple pie that was, honestly, the best anyone has ever had. Tremendous people, tremendous kitchen.
author: Donald J. Trump
note: Synthetic. 'apple' here is generic: should match AAPL at LOW confidence at most, and should not pass the relevance filter.

title: Sanctions package announced
text: New sanctions were announced covering crude oil exports from the region. Chevron licences are being reviewed as part of the package, and the energy sector should expect further announcements.

title: Golf tournament remarks
text: Played a great round today at the club. Beautiful weather, wonderful people, and the course has never looked better.

title: Statement on drug pricing
text: Drug companies are charging Americans far more than they charge other countries. We are reviewing rules to bring those prices down, and pharmaceutical companies should expect action.
author: The White House
